items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1959-06-02
items.q: Manuel Minetti, piano. William Ridgely, Celestine.

ctx.x: I don't remember that record. I have the other three numbers. I have those. Can you tell me who was in the band then when they made those? Can you remember? Was it?
Manuel Minetti, piano. William Ridgely, Celestine. Johnny Sincer. Tom Benton. Chani on drum. Samuel Memorero on bass violin. John Marrero, guitar.
Do you remember on Careless Love somebody plays a little slide whistle? Who was that? Who did that?

items.title: William "Ba Ba" Ridgley Interview, 1961-04-07
items.q: And he was a fine fellow, a fine piano player.

ctx.x: Menela. That's who I want them to speak them. And he was a fine fellow, a fine piano player. For them he didn't do nothin' but teach them them.
Yeah, he's been kind of not feeling too well. A dog bit his hand. I wanted to use him on piano and some things. I wanted to dream up some stuff.
